title: 🐕 DOG NFT FOR  GOODLUCK✨
tagline: Limited edition NFT based on dogs
description: This is a very limited edition dynamic NFT which changes its appearance based on the month of the year.
how_its_made: The main challenge was to learn and do on the go as all of my teammates had to learn and code on the go to participate in this hackathon.. THe main issue we could encounter was that even though we had made the dynamic nft and minted it and listed it on open sea the dynamic nft wasn't visible dynamically because of the slow or the long cache clear time from the opensea side.
